value.rationale: Natural motivated question: positive idempotent group conditional expectations are contractive in their own weighted Lp geometry, but need not reduce unweighted complete-pair dispersion. The result gives a full nonexpansivity polytope; exact largest independent total-variation stability radii; a non-bistochastic contracting example; an exact first dimension four of possible amplification; and a sharp positive-weight envelope growing linearly with dimension for balanced groups. These are structural all-dimensional stability boundaries, not arbitrary sample-specific numerical recalculation.
